findings.evidence: At commit `be01e5a2`, `pkg/executor/detach.go:82` builds `newCtx` and detaches `tableReaderExecutorContext`, but `pkg/executor/detach.go:86` returns `iluCtx`; `IndexLookUpExecutor.Detach()` assigns this result back at `pkg/executor/detach.go:114`, so no detachment occurs. Callers then finalize/cleanup session state after `TryDetach` (`pkg/session/session.go:2407`).
findings.fix: Change `indexLookUpExecutorContext.Detach()` to `return newCtx` so the embedded `tableReaderExecutorContext` is actually detached for the returned executor.
findings.impact: IndexLookUp-based record sets can report successful detachment while still referencing mutable session contexts; after `TryDetach` commits/cleans up the session and the session executes new statements, cursor fetch can observe changed session vars/StmtCtx (wrong results/warnings) and may trigger Go data races or panics under concurrent use.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Still present on `upstream/master` (b75374faa619e24e380292fdbdf0f6fe5bf11943): `indexLookUpExecutorContext.Detach()` still ends with `return iluCtx` (see `upstream/master:pkg/executor/detach.go` around the `iluCtx` Detach method).
findings.verify: Add/extend a test that, after `TryDetach()` on an IndexLookUp query, runs another statement that mutates session vars/StmtCtx while continuing to fetch from the detached recordset; run the focused test under `-race`.
findings.what: IndexLookUp detachment is effectively a no-op: `indexLookUpExecutorContext.Detach()` returns `iluCtx` instead of `newCtx`, so session-bound contexts (DistSQL/Ranger/Expr/BuildPB) are not converted to static contexts for the detached executor.

subject: executor: support detaching the `IndexReader` and `IndexLookUp` (#54800)
summary: Adds Detach support for IndexReaderExecutor/IndexLookUpExecutor, introduces a detach integration test, and changes IndexLookUpExecutor worker WaitGroups to pointers to allow safe copying during detach.
